integrity: The verifier reconstructs the full simplicial complex from all 60 facets, proves H1 is infinite cyclic by unimodular integer reduction, checks an explicit primitive integral cocycle on every face relation, exhausts all 220 three-vertex subsets, and independently enumerates the full 96-element simplicial automorphism group.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns simple edge cycles in the fixed labelled twelve-vertex triangulation. It does not compare other triangulations or geometric metric systoles. The sign split under increasing-label orientations is convention-dependent. A 2004 preprint is bibliographically known only to year resolution, so the date field uses the earliest inspected day-resolved public release.
title: All seventy-six empty triangles are primitive systoles in the twelve-vertex twisted \(S^3\)-bundle
